track.key: E Phrygian (final-drop twist: E Phrygian dominant / Hijaz, G#)
track.loop: seamless: ends with a reverse metal swell resolving into the 0.000 s bronze impact

voice_over_window.note: intro mix leaves 300 Hz-3 kHz space; groove starts 3.529 s

sections.name: intro_opening_hook
sections.description: Bronze impact + bell, distant bull roar, filtered pulse, hook teaser on dark bouzouki; voice-over space

sections.name: first_groove
sections.description: Kick, rolling bass, darbuka, hook on bouzouki + pluck + aulos, HEY/HO responses; layers add every 2 bars

sections.name: escalation
sections.description: Full gang chants, hook variation, vocal chops, davul, rhythmic breaks at bars 10 and 12, crescendo

sections.name: pre_drop
sections.description: Impact + bronze bull roar, filtered hook fragment, breathing, reverse metal sweep + reverse shriek, power HEY, hard silence

sections.name: main_drop
sections.description: Driven bass, full hook stack, choir accents, metallic percussion, horror accents; break before bar 20

sections.name: dark_breakdown
sections.description: Half-time low aulos hook, bouzouki tremolo, accelerating heartbeat, low choir, distant horror vocals, HA build

sections.name: final_drop
sections.description: Strongest hook, cross-rhythm stutter bar, Phrygian-dominant (G#) melodic twist, biggest chants, final roar

sections.name: final_impact_loop
sections.description: Final bronze impact + HO + choir, teaser motif returns, reverse metal swell into 0:00 for seamless replay

verification.note: Times are the musical grid positions used at render time (sample-accurate). Percussion carries +/-2 ms humanisation and odd 16ths are swung by 8.5% of a 16th (~9.4 ms); swung times are already included. Chant times mark the vowel (beat) onset; the breathy 'H' starts ~33 ms earlier.
